name: Long-grain rice
definition: slender non-aromatic rice grains that stay separate when cooked.

name: Basmati rice
definition: the long, aromatic, aged grain of the basmati group.

name: Jasmine rice
definition: the long, soft, fragrant grain of the jasmine group.

name: Medium- and short-grain rice
definition: rounder rice that cooks tender and clings, including sushi and pudding rice and the Indian table rices.

name: Risotto rice
definition: rice sold for risotto because it gives up starch as it cooks.

name: Paella rice
definition: rice sold for paella because it absorbs a lot of stock and stays whole.

name: Glutinous (sticky) rice
definition: rice that turns sticky and translucent when cooked, of any bran colour.

name: Red and black rice
definition: non-glutinous rice with a red or black bran layer left on.

name: Flattened rice (poha)
definition: rice grains steamed or parboiled and rolled flat.

name: Millet

name: Quinoa

name: Wild rice

name: Tapioca pearls (sabudana)

name: Rye flour

name: Spelt flour

name: Whole-wheat atta
definition: finely ground whole-wheat flour for South Asian flatbreads.

name: Semolina (sooji, rava)

name: Chickpea flour (besan)

name: Rice flour
definition: flour milled from rice.

name: Tube pasta

name: Somen

name: Soba

name: Glass noodles (harusame)

name: Potato gnocchi

name: Red kidney beans (rajma)

name: Pigeon peas (toor, arhar)

name: Pecans

name: Chestnuts

name: Desiccated coconut

name: Peanuts

name: Hemp seeds

name: Mixed nuts

definition: oil pressed from sesame seed.

name: Rapeseed oil

name: Sunflower oil

name: Rice vinegar
definition: vinegar made from rice.

name: Malt vinegar

name: Cider vinegar
definition: vinegar made from apple cider.

name: Mirin

name: Cooking wine

name: Cooking sake
definition: sake made or sold for cooking.

name: Saffron

name: Dried chilli and paprika
definition: dried chillies and paprika, whole, flaked or ground.

name: Cumin (jeera)

name: Garam masala
definition: the North Indian ground spice blend.

name: Table salt

name: Kosher salt

name: Flake salt

name: Fleur de sel

name: Pesto

name: Koikuchi soy sauce
definition: the common dark Japanese soy sauce of soybeans and wheat.

name: Usukuchi soy sauce
definition: light-coloured, saltier Japanese soy sauce.

name: Tamari soy sauce
definition: soy sauce brewed mainly from soybeans, with little or no wheat.

name: Saishikomi soy sauce
definition: twice-brewed soy sauce, made with soy sauce in place of brine.

name: Shiro soy sauce
definition: very pale soy sauce made mostly from wheat.

name: Ketchup

name: Mayonnaise

name: Horseradish

name: Salad dressing

name: Chilli oil

name: Chopped tomatoes

name: Passata

name: Tomato purée and paste

name: Tinned sweetcorn

name: Pickled peppers

name: Table olives

name: Sauerkraut

name: Kimchi

name: Dried yeast

name: Malt extract

name: Hops

name: Brewing yeast
